title: Letter: Democratic senators question Meta's $6.6B in federal tax credits claimed over the past two years toward costs of building "experimental" AI data centers (Kashmir Hill/New York Times)
summary: Kashmir Hill / New York Times: Letter: Democratic senators question Meta's $6.6B in federal tax credits claimed over the past two years toward costs of building “experimental” AI data centers — Democrats on the Senate Finance Committee sent a letter to Mark Zuckerberg, Meta's chief executive, questioning the company's $6.6 billion in tax breaks.
